right: Koyi don farashi girke-girke don riba

say: Fara kowane harsashi tare da sakamakon, kuma ƙara takamaiman daki-daki ɗaya. Gasa girke-girke guda 6 da kanku, daga burodi zuwa kek nama. Kuma kawai rubuta shekaru 8 gwaninta idan gaskiya ne.
Zane don wayoyi da farko: gajerun sakin layi, ƙananan hotuna, da maɓalli da babban yatsa zai iya kaiwa.

Misali, Ifeoma tana sayar da masana'anta a Aba. Ta kasance tana ƙara kowane abokin ciniki ba tare da tambaya ba, kuma ta yi ihu da manyan haruffa. Wasu sun tare ta.

left: Duk nau'ikan yadin da aka saka, arha sosai

say: Yanzu ta fara tambaya: Shin kuna son sabbin masu shigowa sau ɗaya a mako? Amsa YES don shiga, kuma TSAYA kowane lokaci.
Sakon nata yana da natsuwa kuma takamaimai: wine Swiss lace ya dawo, yadi 5 akan naira 38,000, guda 14 tare da 6 tanadi. Amsa WINE don ajiyewa ɗaya.

cards.d: Tambayi kafin ƙara kowa, kuma a sauƙaƙe tafiya. Yana mutunta Dokar Kariyar Bayanai 2023.
Watsawa ɗaya zuwa biyu a mako yana aiki mafi kyau fiye da yau da kullun. Haɗa tayi tare da shawarwari masu amfani.
Faɗa lissafin lambar asusun ku, kuma cewa ba ku taɓa tambayar PIN ko OTPs na katin ba.

say: Don tunawa. Yi amfani da PAS don matsalolin ji da AIDA don sha'awa. Bayyana yanayi, ba mutane ba. Gina shafukan tallace-tallace a cikin tsari na tambayoyin mai karatu. Nemi izini kafin watsa shirye-shirye. Kuma ba kowane imel burin guda ɗaya.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: PAS don matsalolin ji, AIDA don sha'awa
Shafin tallace-tallace yana bin tambayoyin mai karatu
Watsa shirye-shirye: izini, batu ɗaya, aiki ɗaya
Imel: manufa ɗaya, yarda, cire rajista

say: Juyin ku. Rubuta nau'ikan talla guda biyu, PAS ɗaya da AIDA ɗaya. Zana shafin tallace-tallace ka tambayi wani abin da ba a sani ba. Aika saƙon izini zuwa abokan ciniki 10 na baya-bayan nan. Kuma shirya jerin imel guda uku.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Rubuta nau'ikan tallan PAS da AIDA
Zana shafin tallace-tallace mai shafi ɗaya
Fara jerin watsa shirye-shirye na tushen izini
